csv_project_name: On-Call A&E Services for Master Engineer Aviation
csv_scope_of_work: Grant County Port District No. 9 "The Port, Port" is requesting interested firms to submit qualifications for on-call professional engineering, survey and master planning consulting services. The Port will retain the services of a Master Engineering Consultant (Aviation) for a period of five (5) years to provide professional engineering, surveying, testing, grant preparation, administrative support, consulting, planning, and construction services, but not limited to, the following projects (or project components): 1. Multi-modal transportation infrastructure planning design, construction and maintenance. 2. Land Development projects within the Port District. 3. Design services for infrastructure & development of lands. 4. Aviation development and revenue support projects. 5. Environmental studies & compliance 6. Other miscellaneous engineering, surveying and planning services.
